targeted_matrix.why: Earlier empty reads/layout evidence did not establish populated queue/storyboard/caption flows.

defects.root: Migration 0030 explicitly supplied nullable=None for six ORM-optional AI job recovery fields, resulting in NOT NULL PostgreSQL columns. Normal queued jobs omitted them and failed.
defects.fix: Migration 0150 drops only those NOT NULL constraints; verifies exact column types/defaults, retains every row/value and refuses unsafe downgrade.
defects.test: Original 50/51 run retains NotNullViolation. Retest 56/56 includes empty roundtrip, NULL rollback refusal and historical non-NULL value preservation; L-01 browser queue/replay.

defects.root: An explicit category with no local fixture reached an uncaught LookupError in execute_run; HTTP 500 replaced a legitimate no-results outcome.
defects.fix: Persist PARTIAL / NO_USEFUL_PRODUCT_CANDIDATES, failed discovery checkpoint and no external writes, matching the existing blocked-research architecture. Never relax the category or add fake candidates.
defects.test: Sanitized LookupError frames in 900ec8ca748fa174; two unavailable categories start/start/retry/reload and database zero opportunities; B-06 actual UI.

defects.root: Business context selector loaded active-brand products only and changing its Brand did not reload products, so later brands could not choose their actual product.
defects.fix: Request the explicit brand, clear old product/artifact/media identities on user brand change, ignore late superseded context responses. Backend ownership guards unchanged.
defects.test: 0b083ed8209c786d mobile/Edge L-01 failure; two new Angular cases plus independent four-context browser retest.

defects.root: addCaption retained previous error/success notices across a new request, so a persisted successful caption still displayed its previous rejection.
defects.fix: Clear prior feedback at the next valid caption attempt, retain authoritative failure and pending HUMAN review semantics.
defects.test: 900ec8ca748fa174 L-02 before evidence; invalid then valid actual caption save/reload, focused Angular failure/retry test.

defects.root: Storyboard cards showed version but no board/product identity; same-version drafts were ambiguous.
defects.fix: Display exact board ID and product ID; no new selection/version authority.
defects.test: 84b191290279edf4 L-03 before evidence; two same-version cards regression; actual editor save and stale row-version conflict.

defects.root: Secondary-action anchors received a dark background but were omitted from the shared button foreground rule; axe measured blue #0000ee on #42616a at 1.4:1.
defects.fix: Include action-link in the existing accessible foreground/padding/theme rule and responsive sizing; no rule suppression.
defects.test: a2626483fc580c9f B-02/B-03/B-06 serious axe findings; later populated-state scans.

defects.root: Decision brief embeds a shared H3 evidence card under an H4 section, followed by H5 summaries, skipping levels.
defects.fix: Configurable semantic heading level with unchanged H3 default; this nested card requests H5.
defects.test: 0b083ed8209c786d B-03 heading-order findings in all four contexts; explicit heading regression and actual axe rescans.

remaining_critical_coverage.reason: Source-observation freshness/staleness under materially changed research inputs has not been exercised. B-05 proves goal/navigation identity, not this broader semantic gate.

Failed-generation worker/job retry and approved immutable storyboard version cloning were not exercised in the browser. Ads saved/observed campaign recovery is not covered by an empty campaign plus taxonomy catalog; no campaign confirmation was admitted.
